item.title: How Kanvas Works with Meshery and Layer5 Cloud
item.description: Kanvas is not a standalone service. It is an extension that runs inside Meshery, relies on Meshery Server to reach your clusters, and relies on a remote provider, Layer5 Cloud, to store and share designs. Knowing which part does what explains why some features need a cluster connection, why others need an account, and why the hosted Kanvas at kanvas.new offers a subset of what a self-hosted Meshery deployment offers.
